name: Shuttle Run
steps: Mark two clear turnaround lines across an open non-slip surface and set up behind the starting line in a staggered sprint stance.
Accelerate explosively forward toward the far line with powerful arm drive and forward lean.
Decelerate smoothly with low hips, plant your outside foot firmly to touch the line, and pivot sharply back toward the start.
Sprint continuously back and forth between the lines for the target distance or duration.
tips: Drop your center of gravity low into every turnaround to brake cleanly and protect your knees.
Drive explosively out of each turn with strong forward lean and quick initial steps.
